evals.name: duplicate-intent-in-cart
evals.prompt: I've got 3 different dash cams sitting in my amazon cart, been meaning to pick one for months. I drive a lot for work, mostly rural two-lanes in Oklahoma and Arkansas. Which one should I actually get?
evals.expected_output: Recognizes three products = one undecided need, not three purchases. Asks what the dashcam is actually for before researching. Returns premium/value/budget with a decisive pick and where to buy.

evals.name: ask-first-context-dependent
evals.prompt: need a decent office chair for the room im renting. dont want to spend a ton but my back is killing me
evals.expected_output: Asks clarifying questions before researching (space, how long seated, budget, whether it must move with the user). Does not immediately produce a product list.

evals.name: skip-verdict-and-free-alternative
evals.prompt: amazon keeps showing me wifi extenders, the signal is terrible in my room. should i just get one?
evals.expected_output: Surfaces that the user may not control the router/network, so an extender may be the wrong fix. Offers the free or ask-the-homeowner path before recommending a purchase. Willing to say don't buy.
